description: A barometric pressure and temperature sensor with an I2C interface (address 0x77).
how_to_use: VCC and 3.3V are two separate power-pin options (use whichever matches your supply), GND ground, SCL/SCA are real I2C — wire to the board's real I2C pins.

plain.what: Measures air pressure and temperature — it can even tell your height above sea level.
plain.how: VIN and GND for power, SDA and SCL to the Arduino's matching pins (A4/A5 on an Uno).
